# The Lantern Child

## Premise
A child raised by lamplighters must carry a living flame across a city that fears it.

## World / Characters
1. Eli, the child entrusted with the last flame
2. Mother Sull, the eldest lamplighter

## Manuscript

### Chapter 1: The Charge
The boy woke in the dark beneath the gasworks. The child did not remember his own face, only the warmth cupped in his hands. The boy rose, because the woman called Mother Sull had told the boy to rise. Down the long pipe the child went, and the boy did not look back. When the child reached the street, the boy hid the flame in his coat. The boy was afraid, but the child kept walking, because the boy had been told that the child was the last one who could.

### Chapter 2: The Crossing
The boy crossed the iron bridge at midnight. The child heard the dousers behind him and the boy ran. The woman had warned the child of this. The boy clutched the flame and the child whispered to it the way the boy had been taught. At the far end of the bridge, for the first time, someone spoke his name — "Eli" — and the boy almost dropped the light. The child did not stop running until the gasworks was far behind.
